For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.
 

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.
 

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
 
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
 
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
 
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
 
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
 
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
 
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
 
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations. 

 
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
 
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
 
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
 
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
 
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
 
• Good physical fitness.
 
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
 
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. The company designs and delivers advanced software and hardware solutions for complex industrial environments in the oil & gas industry, helping customers operate safely, efficiently and in full regulatory compliance.

 

Your New Role
 
As Business Development Manager, you are responsible for driving new business growth across Europe. You focus on opening new doors, building long-term commercial relationships and developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline within large, complex organizations.
 
This is a pure new business role with a long-term perspective. You will work on strategic target accounts with lengthy investment cycles, where success depends on trust-building, market insight, and persistence rather than short-term wins.
 
You work closely with the Sales Manager and internal technical teams and operate in a hybrid model combining office-based work, customer visits and international travel.
 
Key Responsibilities

• Identify, approach and develop new customers and new opportunities across European markets
• Map target regions, industries and strategic accounts and define focused action plans
• Establish relationships with key decision-makers within complex organizations
• Build and manage a qualitative sales pipeline through continuous prospecting and follow-up
• Understand customer processes, strategic challenges and long-term investment roadmaps
• Prepare and deliver tailored presentations, demonstrations and commercial proposals
• Collaborate with internal engineering and solution teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events and conferences
• Maintain structured reporting and pipeline management through CRM tools
• Contribute to long-term growth strategy, forecasting and market development initiatives

• At least 3 years of experience in Business Development within a technical or industrial environment
• Educational background in engineering, industrial technology or IT, or equivalent technical-commercial experience
• Experience or affinity with industries such as energy, process industry, industrial systems or infrastructure is a plus
• Demonstrated ability to generate new business, open new accounts and build relationships from the ground up
• Strong hunter mentality with resilience and confidence in approaching senior stakeholders

• Strong communication and presentation skills at executive and technical levels

About Us: 
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027. 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities
As a OPEX engineer you will drive the continuous improvement culture within the production facility. In this role you will look beyond the surface, diving deep into the process to eliminate waste and scale manufacturing efficiency to the next level.
 

We’re looking for an energetic and enthusiastic personality with excellent communication skills, capable of inspiring and engaging teams to bring meaningful change and challenge the status quo, while respecting strict quality and safety.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Process Optimization: you are responsible for identifying, implementing, and ensuring process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and safety. 

• Follow-up on KPI’s; apply value stream mapping and execute Gemba walks. 

• Based on data driven analysis, you identify hidden opportunities and propose improvements. 

• Lead independently cross functional improvement projects with minimal supervision. 

• Standardization & training: write, revise, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures to embed new best practices firmly into daily operations; deliver training modules to build a site-wide OPEX mindset. Responsible for keeping training matrix up-to-date and organizing training accordingly, in collaboration with the production team lead.  

• Identify root causes of technical anomalies/malfunctions or inefficiencies. 

• Provide support with day-to-day technical problems; act as a point of contact for problem solving. 

• Support implementation of new equipment, systems or workflows. 

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, preventive way of thinking, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. 
 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A master’s degree in engineering/biotech with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a continuous Improvement or OPEX role within a manufacturing environment; 

• Proven track record of applying operational excellence techniques as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in a production setting. 

• Analytical and data-driven, out-of-the-box thinking, solution-oriented mindset, and a hands-on approach. 

• Experience in biochemical process know-how and change-management is a plus. 

• A structured way of working, with an eye of detail, excellent communicator able to engage people, with a drive for continuous improvement. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.

The Solution Lead Secured Connectivity steers Telenet Business' connectivity+ product domain for the SME segment with scalable needs. You own the product domain end-to-end across Fixed Connectivity, Networking (security), scalable SD-WAN and Managed WiFi. You will be combining product backlog, product P&L and people leadership of a multi-disciplinary team of around four product professionals. The Solution Lead Secured Connectivity operates at the boundary between operator-style standardisation and integrator-style configuration, with security as a critical capability layer.

Secured Connectivity is the cluster's most technically nuanced product domain standardised and catalogue-based at its core, but with meaningfully higher configuration than pure telco products and a partner/integrator landscape that demands disciplined vendor management. The cybersecurity boundary with BEAT (where shared platforms and security tooling live) is a critical interface to manage. You will be measured on acquisition & cross-sell into the connectivity base, on ARPU uplift through secured-connectivity attach rates and on the discipline with which deviations from the standard product are governed

 

Your responsibilities as Solution Lead Secured Connectivity

 
• You own the product roadmap and the product P&L for the assigned domain. You steer ARPU, net adds, lifecycle cost and the build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions, and you oversee the financial lifecycle including capex/opex steering and the operational order flow with vendors and partners.
 
• You lead, coach and develop a multi-disciplinary team. As a Solution Lead Secured Connectivity you will set the ways of working (OKRs, agile rituals, governance cadence) and you build the team's technical and commercial maturity.
 
• You translate business needs and CVP priorities (in collaboration with CVP and CX team) into feasible technical solutions together with Product Managers and business Architects. You drive solution feasibility through Quarterly Business Review (QBR) and Big Room Planning (BRP), and you formulate MVP and scale-up decisions.
 
• You own the product backlog. You prioritise features and epics, validate the “definition of ready” at initiative and epic level, drive EPIC-authoring and ensure clean handovers to build, UAT, FUT and operational readiness.
 
• You own the vendor and partnership strategy for the domain (selection decisions, partnership investments, vendor performance, certifications) and you propose pricing and commercial terms in alignment with the pricing Manager and Tribe Operations & Steering.
 
• You govern technical and operational deviation requests raised by the Commercial Tribe's pre-sales teams, deciding what can be accommodated within the product model and what not. You manage the product/pre-sales interface as a critical handoff, and you ensure your team delivers product-introduction training to pre-sales, sales and customer-facing teams.
 
• 
  
You identify dependencies between tribes and domains (BEAT, Commercial, Enterprise Solutions, Delivery & Services, TV Transformation, CVP & CX), mediate conflicts, drive consensus and escalate in time to the Cluster Lead and Tribe Lead.

  
 

Our ideal Solution Lead Secured Connectivity

 
• You combine technical depth with commercial product accountability, relevant platforms, applications and network technology, with hands-on product management experience (lifecycle, pricing, market positioning, go-to-market).
 
• You have a Master / Engineering / ICT degree (or equivalent through experience) and 8+ years in telecom or ICT, of which a minimum of 3 years in a (digital) product owner or senior product management role.

scaled-agile ways of working (SAFe, scrum, PI Planning, scrum-of-scrums) and you bring them to life as a working method, not as ceremony. You own scope, time and budget.
